description:
COMPANY PROFILE

ST Analytics was founded in Munich in May 2015 as an independent tech consulting company focused on rocket technologies and spaceflight, including analyses and assessments of these technologies in the commercial area as well as in the defence sector. The customer base includes small aerospace companies as well as industrial aerospace giants, governmental institutions, tech journals, and venture capital investors. ST Analytics is part of the EDIDP/EDF consortiums for ODIN’S EYE I & II.

MISSION STATEMENT

Analysis, consulting, and project management services in the fields of spaceflight, rocketry, and high technology.

PRODUCTS AND SERVICES

-	Technical analyses, feasibility studies, market evaluations, simulations, expert opinions, comprehensive research (under technical, economic, and political aspects) in the fields of rockets, space, defence.

-	Performance reconstructions and threat assessments in the fields of ballistic and cruise missiles.

-	Technical due diligence for Start-Up investors, with special focus on rocket and space applications.

-	Consulting services for new fields of business, project management, support at technology transfer.

-	Seminars, lectures, and training courses.

entityDescription:
Henddu is a France-based startup that develops smart air quality and climate observatories tailored for developing countries starting in Africa. By leveraging a digital platform powered by proprietary algorithms, Henddu offers a cost-effective solution—up to 6 times cheaper in capital expenditure and 10 times in operating costs than traditional systems. The platform integrates diverse data sources including satellite Earth observation, ground sensors, meteorology, and health indicators to provide real-time environmental intelligence. Its space-based data fusion, using services like Sentinel and CAMS, enables hyperlocal pollution forecasting (HOQA), hotspot detection (Henddu-Spot), and vulnerability mapping (Henddu-Cluster). This multidimensional approach strengthens public policy, institutional capacity, and community engagement through actionable, data-driven insights. Henddu empowers governments and industries to shift from passive monitoring to predictive and strategic environmental governance—driven by both space and ground intelligence.
Henddu is supported by Inria Startup Studio, ESA BIC Nord France, Euratechnologies and the French Public Investment Bank (Bpifrance), and collaborates closely with academic partners such as Inria, the University of Lille, and CNES.

entityDescription:
Lynx Educate is a France-based education startup and strategic consultancy dedicated to advancing sustainability, innovation, and inclusive development through transformative learning. With operations in France and Algeria, and partnerships across Africa, Europe, and Latin America, Lynx combines digital education delivery with strategic advisory in global education, environmental science and NewSpace.Our approach, built around Impact Learning, fosters curiosity, agency, and engagement with real-world challenges. We empower learners to become drivers of change through interdisciplinary, action-oriented pedagogy.
Lynx Educate has a strong axis of expertise in NewSpace and sustainability, spanning both upstream and downstream space activities. We support educational and innovation programs focused on Earth Observation, satellite applications, and space-sector entrepreneurship. Our global network of space experts, particularly in Europe and Africa, enables us to deliver cutting-edge content and foster collaborative innovation.
We have launched digital universities, conducted sustainability training for large organizations, and advised academic institutions on international expansion. Our network includes a wide range of academic and professional partners in global education, sustainability and Space, enabling tailored responses to diverse learning and development needs.
A core mission of Lynx is capacity building and knowledge transfer to Africa. We are committed to strengthening Africa’s space ecosystem by delivering training, mentoring, and institutional support, with a focus on empowering local talent and promoting equitable access to space opportunities.

As a participant in the AfricaSpace initiative, Lynx Educate, along with its Algerian partners, aims to contribute meaningfully to the joint goals of ESA and AfSA by supporting digitalisation, climate resilience, and the growth of a robust, inclusive African space sector through education and strategic collaboration.

entityDescription:
Koole is a trusted provider of industrial and maritime services, specializing in wreck removal, industrial demolition, hazardous material remediation, and emergency response.

Koole started 40 years ago as a family business in demolition and has grown to over 250 employees while maintaining a hands-on approach and focus on quality. Our success comes from empowering people and our flexible, adaptable team. What sets us apart is our integration of onshore and offshore operations and the ability to quickly scale up in emergencies with our own equipment.

Koole originally started as a demolition company within the industrial sector but has since grown into an international company working onshore and offshore.
Onshore Division specializes in demolition and industrial cleaning for industries like food, pharmaceutical, petrochemical and power plants. Services include hazardous material removal, dry ice cleaning, and 24/7 emergency response/support.
Offshore Division handles complex maritime challenges worldwide. With specialized equipment and skilled personnel, koole manage salvage operations, wreck removal, maritime construction and emergency response efficiently. 

Our fleet of tug vessels and barges is equipped to handle a wide range of maritime challenges. From navigating complex waterways, transporting heavy cargo, or supporting offshore operations. Besides the offshore equipment Koole has also a various and specialized range of demolition equipment, excavators (UHD), wheelloaders, trucks, lowbed trailers, truck mounted cranes, forklift and supporting tools like working containers, storage containers, AWP, generators for power supply, industrial cleaning trucks, sweepers, etc.
In addition to our own projects, we also work with third parties, providing flexible solutions to meet various needs.

entityDescription:
The SWE research group has strong expertise in space weather. More than 50 peer reviewed papers related to the Sun-Earth interaction guarantee the experience acquired in the framework of both national and international projects. Not only improving scientific knowledge on the Solar-Terrestrial interaction is the main goal for SWE, but also the development of space weather products, where the research group has proven experience in leading the Spanish Space Weather Service (http://www.senmes.es/) and providing products to the ESA SSA SWE Network (http://swe.ssa.esa.int/) through the Geomagnetism-Expert Centre. We also operate and maintain the Space Weather Station at the University of Alcala.
Regarding ESA activities, the SWE-UAH group has led two ESA contracts:
P3-SWE-XXXVII, SWE Products for Southern Europe - Phase 1, and
P3-SWE-XXIII, Space Weather User Needs for the Mediterranean Region. Now we are part of the consortium led by the Royal Belgian Institute for Space Aeronomy in the contract S2P - S1-SW-02.2, S1-SW-05, S1-SW-06 - Space Weather Service Network Development and Pre-Operation Part. All the previous contracts demonstrate the experience of the team in validating space weather products and implementing them in the ESA Portal through the SSO system. Users’ campaign to get feedback of our products were also developed in the framework of these contracts.
The SWE group has also participated in the ESA contract Synergetic use of SMOS L1 Data in Sun Flare detection and analysis, which allow us to propose the SMOS Mission for Space Weather Operations, considering the potential of near real-time solar observation at 1.4 GHz from MIRAS instrument.

Goujon Systems is a specialized consulting firm founded by Clément Goujon, a recognized expert in Systems Engineering and MBSE for complex systems. The company provides advanced consulting services in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), system architecture design, and technical project leadership for cutting-edge aerospace and high-technology programs.
Clément Goujon brings over 8 years of experience as a Lead System Architect and Technical Leader in a top space player in Europe and in the world. His expertise spans end-to-end systems engineering, including requirements definition and management, functional and physical architecture design, trade-off analysis, and system-level integration. He is highly proficient in the deployment and governance of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) throughout the entire project lifecycle, as well as developing MBSE new capabilities through R&D studies.
Goujon Systems is committed to helping organizations navigate the complexity of modern system engineering challenges with rigor, clarity, and creativity.

entityName: Sapienza University of Rome - Dipartimento di Ingegneria Chimica Materiali e Ambiente (DICMA)
entityDescription:
Il Dipartimento di Ingegneria Chimica Materiali Ambiente (DICMA) ha assunto il nome attuale nel 2006.
La sua storia inizia con l'istituzione del Gabinetto di Chimica Docimastica, dedicato all'insegnamento della Chimica Organica ed Inorganica (1873) e della Chimica Applicata dei Materiali da Costruzione (1876). Questa organizzazione, originariamente destinata alle discipline della Chimica Applicata, si è evoluta nel corso degli anni in seguito agli sviluppi della Chimica Industriale e ha trovato la sua struttura moderna nella fondazione dell'Istituto di Chimica Applicata e Industriale nel 1932. Nel corso degli anni, le responsabilità originarie inerenti all'industria chimica si sono ampliate fino a includere tutte le aree dell'ingegneria chimica, della scienza dei materiali e della metallurgia. Nel 1983, quando sono stati istituiti i dipartimenti universitari, questo Istituto è stato riorganizzato insieme all'Istituto delle Arti Minerarie nel Dipartimento di Ingegneria Chimica, Materiali Materie Prime e Metallurgia, nome che ha mantenuto fino al 2006.
Dal 1895 l'Istituto e poi il Dipartimento hanno la loro sede nell'adiacente palazzo in stile classico di via delle Sette Sale nel complesso di San Pietro in Vincoli.

AIRBUS Operations GmbH belongs to the major aerospace company in Europe. The company is engaged in the development and manufacture of advanced high performance commercial transport aircraft and is recognized for its technological expertise in nearly all fields of aeronautical engineering.
 
R&TD capabilities of AIRBUS Operations GmbH cover all aspects of aircraft design and optimization (aerodynamics, aerolastics, structures, weights, performances, operating costs, environmental aspects etc.), airframe and systems development and engine integration.
 
Recent examples for research projects, which are coordinated by Airbus Operations GmbH and are carried out in European Programmes: 
 
· HORIZON2020
· HORIZON Europe
· JTI Clean Sky 2 (LPA, AIRFRAME, SYSTEMS)
· Clean Aviation (e.g. ACAP, FASTER H2, UP WING)
· EASA
 
Within Airbus, Airbus Operations GmbH is particularly responsible for the development and production of the major part of the fuselage including systems and passenger cabin, the vertical fin, the equipment of the wings and the final assembly of narrow-body aircrafts (A318, A319, A320, A321) and partly of the A350.
